ev_0006.summary: Consolidated geometry for figure 295_q_fig1 using supervisor-verified labels P, E, D, B, C. Five labelled vertices and five solid segments form a figure: top line PD (through E), diagonal PB, vertical EB, bottom BC, and diagonal CD. A verified right-angle mark sits at E between ED and EB, so EB is perpendicular to PD at E. Segment endpoints are snapped to the labelled vertices, since the CV overshoots are within about 6 px. circle_01 (center (307.7,180.2), r=116.6) is excluded as a spurious detection, and no arc objects are submitted. Auxiliary CV points (point_06 to point_11, which are the circle centre, extra points on the top line and bottom edge, and interior points) are not part of the figure and are dropped.
